name: The Ember Crypt
author: Verdite
description: A sigil that opens a crypt of brutes, and the draught they drop. Example of kf.content, kf.hook, kf.call, kf.raw and exports. The crypt needs a floor from your own disc: tools/mod_floor_from_disc.py KF/B1 mods/crypt/floors/crypt. Without it the sigil rouses brutes where you stand.
